190. The Legacy of Mariette Hister (4)
As Mariette spoke, the scenery suddenly changed.
September 7, 1391.
Five months after Mariette revealed her curse to Honka, Jin and Valeria took a look around again.
All around, buildings were burning and collapsing, screams of someone could be heard. The smell of blood and ashes was everywhere.
'...It's a battlefield. Those guys, are they wraith troops?'
'It seems to be the time when our ancestor and Zipfel are fighting.'
Kwaang-!
Suddenly, an explosion occurred in front of the two, revealing Mariette's figure.
She had just blocked the magic of the wraith troops with a shield.
"I didn't expect you to show up here, Mariette Hister. How did you get in?"
Despite being surrounded by five wraith troops, Mariette didn't lose her composure. Instead, she smirked and replied,
"How did I get in? I just came."
The wraith troops didn't show any signs, but they were wrapped in confusion.
The location of the battlefield they were fighting in was Drakka.
Even though it was the outskirts, one of the most wanted people by Zipfel appeared in the capital of the Lutero Magic Federation.

"Do you think I know that your leader and the house head are currently absent, or do I not? The answer is I know. What does that mean? There are no forces in Drakka that can stop me now. So, let's just pass by quietly. I only need to find one person."
Moreover, there existed a secret underground prison on the outskirts of Drakka.
Mariette came to rescue Locke Hister, who was imprisoned there.
"You don't want unnecessary casualties either, right? Consider it as you've been fooled today and just go back. Anyway, you guys mostly win when you fight against our family."

"True, if you think about your original position, it might be better for you, Locke Hister isn't such an important person either. But, we know your situation too. The Blood of Kain. I don't know how you're enduring the pain, but the curse our leader put on you is definitely effective."
Normally, if one was affected by the Blood of Kain, at most, they could hold out for a month. It's been already 2 years for Mariette.
Mariette shrugged her shoulders without responding.
"Well, if you want to die so much, I can't help it."
"You keep bluffing. If you were the old you, we should all be dead by now. Attack!"
As the commander's words fell, the wraith troops started attacking again.
The corpses of Zipfel mages scattered all around were randomly torn apart by their magic.
Mariette was sinking into the painful sensation of her blood boiling due to the curse.
But even in the midst of that, she swung her staff and repelled the enemy's magic.
Even though the house head and the wraith commander were absent, if the battle was prolonged even a little, it was impossible for her to get out alive.
Here is the translated text from Korean to English:
This place was the heartland of Zipfel, where reinforcements would endlessly stream in.
Because of this, Marliat decided to take a gamble.
Even if the curse amplified further, she made the decision to raise her magical power and end everything in a single breath.
Hister's arcane magic, the second succession,
The Spear of Gold
When Marliat finished the summoning spell, suddenly, golden magical power formed a huge cloud in the sky.
Within it, thousands of small golden spears and one massive golden spear poured out.
Both Jin and Valeria were momentarily at a loss for words at the power of the magic.
The golden spears, falling like rain, tore apart the protective shield of the Phantom Troop in an instant.
The largest spear was stuck in the center of the battlefield, endlessly emitting waves of magic power.

The Phantom Troops, who were trying to reestablish the protective shield, had no choice but to scatter to avoid the waves of magic power, and Marliat simultaneously unleashed another elemental magic spell to intercept them one by one.
“Ka-hak……!”
Marliat spit out a mouthful of blood. She could feel the energy of the curse rapidly amplifying.
Among the Phantom Troops, two people survived, but both had suffered damage to the point where they couldn't fight.
Rather than finishing them off, Marliat moved forward and opened a record window.
On the record window, the location of the underground prison where Rok Hister was imprisoned was described.
When she broke the floor of one collapsed building, the entrance to the underground prison was revealed.
"Who, who are you! Save me!"
"Please save us!"
Those imprisoned had been hearing the vibrations and noise of the battle outside while trapped underground.
A few wardens pointed their swords and wands at Marliat, but she ignored them. They didn't dare to confront Marliat and ran out of the prison.
"Rok! Where are you?"
Marliat shouted as she broke each prison door.
Those released from the prison thanked Marliat briefly before quickly running away.
When she didn't hear a response from Rok, she opened the record magic again. There were many scattered records nearby, so it took a while for the results to appear.
The record that appeared about 5 minutes later stated that Rok Hister was already dead. Marliat bit her lower lip and bowed her head.
Rok was her lover.
However, she was not given time to collect her lover's body.
Noise was spreading from the ground again.
"It's the underground prison! Pour magic into the prison!"

The ceiling of the prison collapsed entirely under the magic bombarded by Zipfel's reinforcements. Marliat extended her protective shield while frantically searching for Rok's body, but most of the prison was already engulfed in magical flames.
Just as she was about to start her escape, feeling a sinking sensation,
Marliat heard a voice. It was the voice of a child pleading to be saved.

When she opened the door where the sound came from, there was a child who looked about eight years old. Seeing the color of the child's hair, Marliat hesitated for a moment, but then she reached out her hand to the child.
"Let's get out of here together."

Taking the child with her, Malliet swept through the Zephyr reinforcements outside the prison. It took two days to escape and finally reach a safe hideout. As soon as they arrived, her body, heavy as a thousand pounds, collapsed onto the ground.
When she regained consciousness, the first thing she saw was the child, trembling, holding a dagger and looking down at her. It was one of the daggers from the hideout.
"...Are you going to stab me with that knife?"
The child didn't answer, but gritted his teeth.
"I knew you were a Zephyr child when I saved you. You were probably an illegitimate child of their family, or you were locked up there because you saw something you shouldn't have."
Malliet recognized that the child might think that if he killed her, he might be able to return to his family.
"Put down the knife, you're still innocent. I'll give you a chance to live. Not as an expendable pawn or a puppet of Zephyr, but as a human being."
The child hesitated, then buried himself in Malliet's embrace, still holding the dagger. Malliet effortlessly swatted away the child's dagger with her hand. The child fell and began to cry.
"You didn't manage to stab me, so you're still innocent. Let's go with that. Once I've recovered, I'll prepare a foundation for you to live on. Let's forget about the past and start anew."
Malliet, more than anyone else, despised Zephyr.
Yet she didn't want to harbor hatred towards children who had never participated in the fierce family wars.
A week later, when she was able to move again, Malliet took the child to the lands of the beastfolk and disguised him.
She gave him a new background, made him an identity card.
Now the child was going to live as a commoner named Eello, not Elgia Zephyr.

"Eello, I've lost many family members and lovers to Zephyr in my life. Nevertheless, the reason I saved you is because, in truth, you and I are in the same situation. Despite being born a Zephyr, you were abandoned by them and lost your family."
Eello burst into tears and clung to Malliet.

"Escape from the chain of hatred and live your life. There's no need for revenge since you don't have any other siblings. Both my family and yours need more children like you. Children who choose to live their own lives instead of fighting."
"Malliet... How can I ever repay this kindness?"
"Living a good life from now on is the only way to repay me. And when you're in a situation where you can reach out to someone, do as I did. Grow bright and cheerful, Eello."
Malliet didn't know what kind of life Eello led afterwards.
But until the day Malliet faced her destined death, there was no intrusion from Zephyr into the hideout where she and Eello had hidden.
Afterwards, the life of Malliet that Jin and Valeria saw was all like that.
She protected many Hysteria from Zephyr, and saved many people. Yet, she did not seem to bear a heavy burden on her shoulders.
She did not seem lonely, nor did she succumb to sorrow and despair, nor did she turn into a monster consumed by hatred.
"Just like a person enjoying life. She regarded every single action of hers as valuable work, and it was not out of obligation or mission, but the appearance of a person following their own beliefs.
Even the curse of death, known as Khaian's blood, couldn't darken her.
On December 20, 1393, winter.
Malriet finished the golem for her successor at the traditional site on Honka Island.
"I'm glad I could finish it in time. Golem, I was going to name you when you were completed. But on second thought, it might be better for my successor to name you."
[Understood, master.]

"Your hometown, my traditional site is dangerous, but if you have skills you won't die, and it's designed to grow the passerby who passes all. If there is someone who ignores the traps and takes a shortcut, check their hair and magical power. If it's a complete magical body with red color, then it's a successor, and you have to take the additional test."
[I will remember, master. If a shortcut user is Zipfel. All secret traps, self-destruction device, activation, apply first class hostility.]
"Right. Then I should go now... I'm sorry I couldn't make more memories with you."
[I also, regret, master. But, master, you must go. To the last place, of life, you have chosen.]
Malriet, who had been cursed to the extreme, was not as magnificent as before. Her skeletal figure was still remarkable, but she looked emaciated. But her eyes were still full of playful energy.
Malriet turned her head towards the void. Where Jin and Valeria were standing.
"Descendants, this is the last story I, Malriet Hister, can tell you."
Those who shoulder only their fate cannot change the world.
Even if they do change it, something goes wrong. As many of my family and colleagues became monsters.
After saying so, Malriet took a hard breath.

"You don't have to become a monster because you are fighting a monster family called Zipfel. Fight when you have to fight, and give love when you need to give love. Sometimes you have to forgive the bloodline of your enemy. Don't push your life into a barren and desolate place just because you have to fulfill your duties and missions. Live brightly and briskly."
For a while, Malriet looked at the void where Jin and Valeria were watching and smiled.
Then she went outside and bid farewell to Honka.
[... Are you leaving?]
"Yes, I think I'll die in about five hours. I was wondering whether to spend my last moments comfortably by your side... But I think I should go. To Rok."
[A farewell.]
"Yes, a farewell. I'm relieved, except for the uncomfortable feeling that you won't leave here even after I die."
Honka didn't reply, just hugged Malriet. Just like the first time she hugged him. Tears fell as her stiff, dried body touched his.
[Let's meet again someday.]

"Yes, Honka. Oh, keep an eye on the successors who come here until you feel like leaving the island. I'm saying to watch if they perform the conditions I left behind correctly, it'll be a small pleasure."
So Malriet headed to the outskirts of Drakka, where she had not been able to recover Rok's body.
The record of Malriet was coming to an end like that."
